Definition: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun πός (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as G4225 used with the rising slide of inquiry); as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality:--where, whither.
BiblicalUsage: Pou asks where, whither, and it carries the Bible's hardest questions. Paul asks, where is the wise, where is the scribe, and John says the man in darkness knows not whither he goes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that where questions without Christ have no answer, and the wise of this world are lost in the dark they chose.
